set.body:
Goal: route multiset / direct-sum studies through secondOrder on block operators, and promote the multiset objective algebra from multiset-only to THE universal objective + structural-term layer used by every method. Design: docs/plans/multivar-operator-core.md §6, §10 (Phase 4).

DirectSumStudy builds block-diagonal X_oplus without dense storage; the block cross operators S_st are secondOrder(x_s, L_st, x_t) with the row-side block link. The MultisetObjectives algebra (ObjectiveFormula, ObjectiveNormalization, SolverFormulation, SolvedToReportedRelationship, ConstraintSemantics, HardScoreConstraint, BoundedScoreConstraint, quadraticPenalty) is generalized so GPCA/LDA/CCA/PLS all build their objectives, penalties, and constraints from it — one shared closed layer, no multiset-only copy. Keep BlockDesign (which views interact) separate from row relationships (which observations interact) per the constitution.

Acceptance: existing multiset/DirectSumStudy/MultisetAssociation suites pass on JVM+JS; block operators are built via secondOrder; the objective/term layer is the same code used by the single-view and paired methods; matrix-free block assembly preserved (no accidental densification). When this lands, the dual-layer language is removed from docs/plans/multivar-duality-constitution.md and multivar-operator-core.md becomes its implemented "operator core" section.
set.title: Multivar: route direct-sum multiset through secondOrder; promote MultisetObjectives to the universal objective+term layer
